strings.(비나가 하품하다 다가오는 모험가와 눈이 마주친다.): (Binah yawns, then meets the approaching adventurer's eyes.)
strings.냐하아암. 잘 자긴 했는데, 자도 자도 졸려서 하품이 계속 나와요. 고양: Mee-yawn. I did, but no matter how much I sleep, I'm still sleepy and keep yawning. Maybe it's because I'm a cat.
strings.(그러고 보니 카이로스도 항상 자고 있었지….): (Come to think of it, Kairos was always sleeping too...)
strings.비나가 참여하는 연주회는 언제 볼 수 있어요?: When can I see a concert you're performing in?
strings.헤헤, 글쎄요. 허우적대면서 연습하는 건 언제라도 보실 수 있는데, 연주: Hehe, who knows? You can watch me stumble through practice anytime, but I don't know about a concert.
strings.합주에 맞춰 연습한지 얼마 안됐거든요. 그래도 최근에 많이 늘었다고 칭찬: I only started practicing with the ensemble recently. Still, they've praised me for improving a lot lately.
strings.먼치킨 창고 들어가서 바로 앞에서요. 조금 더 들어가면 길을 잃어버리거든: Right inside the entrance of the Munchkin Warehouse. If I go any farther, I get lost.
Meowhahaha. You wouldn't know if you've only just arrived in the village.
strings.먼치킨 창고가 길을 잃어버릴 정도로 엄청 커요. 저기, 저 끝에 티팟 형: The Munchkin Warehouse is so enormous that you can get lost. See that teapot-shaped building at the far end?
strings.저 건물 엄청 예쁜데, 창고라고요?: That lovely building is a warehouse?
strings.냥. 보기엔 작아 보여도 안에는 엄청나게 넓은 창고랍니다. 레티 언니가: Meow. It looks small, but it's incredibly spacious inside. I barely managed to stop Letty from going in.
strings.(레티는 그새 비나하고 친해진 건가…?): (Has Letty already become friends with Binah...?)
Once, I went farther and farther inside on an errand for Mom and barely managed to get rescued.
strings.정령하고 먼치킨 일족이 나왔다 들어가던데, 저들은 괜찮은 거예요?: Spirits and Munchkins go in and out. Are they all right?
strings.냥. 저도 그게 신기해요. 정말 그 넓은 창고를 구석 구석 다 알고 있어: Meow. I find it amazing too. They know every corner of that enormous warehouse.
I was wandering around, wondering if there were any interesting stories about the village.
strings.그렇다면 제가 엄마가 부탁한 일을 처리하고 말씀드릴게요. 달의 정기를 받: Then I'll tell you after I finish what Mom asked me to do. I need to put the mandrake sleeping in the moon's energy into the warehouse...
I need to put it away, but...
strings.꺄악. 매, 맨드레이크…. 너 어, 어디갔니?: Eek! M-Mandrake... Wh-Where did you go?
strings.%s 님, 어떡하죠? 어떡하죠?: %s, what do I do? What do I do?
The happy m-mandrake has disappeared. Mee-owww.
strings.마법 재료로도 쓰는 진귀한 약초인데, 창고에 보관하기 전에 달빛이 좋은: It's a rare herb used in magic too. Before storing it, we leave it outside to dry on a night with good moonlight.
strings.달빛을 보고 행복해하면서 잠이 들어서 제가 행복한 맨드레이크라고 이름 붙: It looked so happy at the moonlight and fell asleep, so I named it Happy Mandrake...
It's not as though an herb has legs.
strings.아니, 그러니까요. 정말 마력이 좀 있는 애들은 발도 없는데 막 도망간다: That's just it. Some with a little magic really do run away, even without legs.
Meow... I have to find it before Mom notices...
strings.냥. 저기 %s 님. 이왕 이렇게 된 거 제 부탁을 들어주실 수 있나요?: Meow. Um, %s. Since things have turned out like this, could you do me a favor?
strings.행복한 맨드레이크를 찾아주세요. 제가 마을을 돌아볼 테니, 모험가님은 가: Please find Happy Mandrake. I'll search the village, so could you search the road...?
I-I-I'll tell you a ghost story about the Munchkin Warehouse.
strings.냐하하하. 역시 재미있는 이야기라면 괴담이죠!: Meowhahaha. Nothing beats a ghost story for entertainment!
strings.괴담이라…. 가도로 나가서 맨드레이크를 찾으면 되는 거죠?: A ghost story... So I just go out to the road and find the mandrake?
strings.네…. 만다라바가 가도에 있는 건 전부 다 알고 있으니까 제 이야길 하면: Yes... Mandarava knows everything along the road. Mention me, and he'll help.
strings.알았어요. 그런데 이 일… 글린다 님한테는 역시 비밀이겠죠?: All right. But this is... a secret from Glinda, right?
strings.엄마에겐 비밀이에요. 모험가님, 감샤합니다. 냥. 찾으시면 여기로 오세요: A secret from Mom. Thank mew, adventurer. Meow. Come here when you find it.
strings.(그사이 잠이 다 깬 비나가 고양이 모양 집 위로 점프해 주위를 둘러본다: (Now fully awake, Binah jumps onto a cat-shaped house and surveys the area. Unable to spot the mandrake, she hangs her head.)
It doesn't seem to be in the village...
I can't just rest forever. I'll take a quick trip to the road.
strings.(가도를 돌아다니던 중, 글린다와 처음 만났던 장소에 발걸음이 멈춘다.): (While wandering the road, you stop at the place where you first met Glinda.)
(There is still nothing visible between the trees where the emerald light appeared. Instead, Mandarava lies in front of them, gazing at the sky.)
Ah, so warm. Sunlight is best for plants. The very best.
strings.나는 다 놀고 쉬는 거야. 아, 아니지. 열심히 일하고 쉬는 거야. 이거: I'm resting after playing. Oh, no. Resting after working hard. Look. I found some good herbs.
strings.(만다라바가 지퍼를 열고 안에 들어있던 약초 몇 개를 꺼낸다.): (Mandarava opens his zipper and takes out several herbs.)
...I was only joking. You must have a guilty conscience.
strings.나는 결백한 정령이야! 그런데 너, 왜 마을 밖에 나왔냐? 마을에 지내는: I'm an innocent spirit! But why are you outside the village? While you're staying there, you should avoid coming out.
strings.네게 무슨 일이 있는 것 같은데 맞아? 맞는 거야?: Something has happened, hasn't it? Hasn't it?
Binah asked me to do something.
I thought perhaps another mandrake had escaped.
Does that happen often? That's actually why I'm here...
strings.가끔 특이한 맨드레이크가 도망간다. 보통은 글린다, 비나, 루노, 내 선: Occasionally, an unusual mandrake runs away. Usually Glinda, Binah, Runo, or I catch it and bring it back.
But yesterday's wasn't an unusual herb.
strings.달빛을 맞으며 이야기를 나눴었지. 달의 정기를 받아 잠이 들면 좋은 약이: We talked in the moonlight. I told it not to worry: once it absorbed the moon's energy and fell asleep, it would make good medicine.
As a senior herb, I told it that's just how our one-and-only herbal lives go... Hmm.
So you're the culprit. You practically pushed it to escape.
It's Happy Mandrake. It was smiling. A smiling face means happiness.
Should I talk to Iris about managing spirits?
You're so cruel. Look, I'm begging you. I was wrong. Keep it a secret from the goddess.
strings.나는 너와 같이 행복한 맨드레이크 찾을게. 아니, 반드시 찾아내겠다고!: I'll find Happy Mandrake with you. No, I'll definitely find it!
strings.약초 정령이니까 금방 찾을 수 있겠지?: You're an herb spirit, so you should find it quickly, right?
If I think about not wanting Glinda to scold me, I'll find it in no time.
If you don't want to be scolded, you should behave better.
strings.너도 그런 적 있지 않아? 의도하지 않았는데 결과가 꼬이는 그런 경우 말: Hasn't that happened to you? You don't mean any harm, but everything goes wrong. That's exactly what this is.
strings.(그 말과 함께 만다라바가 %s의 어깨 위로 날아와 앉는다.): (With those words, Mandarava flies up and sits on %s's shoulder.)
strings.바보같이 있지 마. 이대로 가만히 있으면 안 된다. 너와 나는 행복한 맨: Don't stand there like a fool. We can't stay still. You and I are catching Happy Mandrake. Oh, over there! There!
I feel like I've become a mount...
strings.(일단 행복한 맨드레이크를 찾아야 하니까 만다라바 말대로 해볼까…?): (We need to find Happy Mandrake, so I'll try following Mandarava's instructions...)
strings.엄마가 이런 걸로 혼내진 않겠지. 아냐, 혼날 거야. 어쩌겠어. 인생이: Mom wouldn't scold me for this, right? No, she will. What can I do? That's life. Hang in there, Binah. Huh?
strings.(비나가 멀리서 모험가가 들고 오는 걸 보더니 눈을 번뜩인다.): (Binah spots what the adventurer is carrying from afar, and her eyes light up.)
Binah, here's the herb you mentioned.
strings.만다라바가 찾는 걸 도와줬어요. 전날 자기가 선배라고 약초한테 무슨 이야: Mandarava helped me find it. Yesterday, he gave the herb some advice as its senior...
strings.냥. 정령님은 정령이니까 약초한테 선배 노릇하지 말라고 내가 몇 번 말했: Meow. Dear spirit, how many times have I told you that you're a spirit, so stop acting like the herbs' senior?
strings.그 이야기를 들은 맨드레이크 열셋은 다 어디 갔을까요?: And where did all thirteen mandrakes who heard that advice go?
They all ran off and hid along the road...
No new stuffing for you for a while. Meow.
strings.솜 안 넣고 좀 참을래요? 엄마한테 혼날래요?: Would you rather go without stuffing for a bit, or be scolded by Mom?
A-All right. Hmph. You really are Glinda's daughter. You even take after her in that.
...I'm sorry. I'll be more careful from now on.
Neither of you sounds like your usual self...
Oh, really? Hehe. It's nothing. It's just how Mandarava and I communicate.
Binah, I'll put the herbs I found in the warehouse.
strings.그러면 얘도 함께 데리고 가. 나올 때 새 솜 가지고 오는 것도 잊지 말: Then take this one too. And don't forget to bring new stuffing when you come out.
strings.새 솜! 비나, 너는 참 좋은 녀석이야. 빨리 창고에서 약초 넣고 솜 찾: New stuffing! Binah, you're wonderful. I'll hurry to put the herbs away and get it!
strings.(만다라바가 행복한 맨드레이크를 붙잡고 서둘러 먼치킨 창고가 있는 방향으: (Mandarava grabs Happy Mandrake and flies hurriedly toward the Munchkin Warehouse.)
So that's one way to handle a spirit.
Hehe. I'm glad we found it before Mom noticed.
strings.이제 해준다고 했던 이야기를 들을 수 있을까요?: Can I hear the story you promised now?
Huh... Did I pick up Letty's way of talking after spending all day with her yesterday?
strings.그러면 말씀드릴게요. 창고 제일 깊은 구역에 매일 밤마다 날뛰는 토끼 괴: Then I'll tell you. They say a rabbit monster lives in the deepest part of the warehouse and rampages every night.
strings.창고가 워낙 넓어서 먼치킨 일족이 종종 안을 탐험하거든요. 그런데 어느: The warehouse is so huge that the Munchkins sometimes explore it. One day, the explorers came running out in terror.
When I asked what frightened them, they said 'giant devil rabbit' and fainted.
strings.루노 아저씨가 알아보려고 창고에 들어갔지만, 너무 복잡해서 아무것도 알아: Uncle Runo went inside to investigate, but it was so complicated that he couldn't find anything.
strings.덕분에 정리 잘하는 아저씨가 어지럽혀진 창고 정리만 일주일 동안 하고 나: Instead, being good at tidying, he spent a whole week organizing the messy warehouse before coming out. Meow.
strings.진짜 대왕 악마 토끼가 있는지도 잘 모르겠어요. 그래서 제가 괴담이라고: I don't even know whether a giant devil rabbit really exists. That's why I called it a ghost story.
strings.%s 님, 설마 들어가보려고 하는 건 아니죠?: %s, you aren't thinking of going inside, are you?
strings.제가 들어가서 확인해 봐도 될까요?: Would it be all right if I went in and checked?
Meow. You can, but remember, I tried to stop you.
strings.(마을을 산책하고 있었는지 레티시아가 모험가와 비나를 발견하고는 뛰어온다: (Apparently out for a walk, Leticia spots the adventurer and Binah and runs over.)
strings.어, 레티 언니? 창고에 있다는 토끼 괴물 이야기했어요. 모험가님이 창고: Oh, Letty? I was telling the adventurer about the rabbit monster in the warehouse. They want to go inside...
I don't mind you coming, but...
strings.(어쩌면 레티시아가 길을 잘 찾을지도 모르겠네.): (Maybe Leticia will be good at finding the way.)
A warehouse full of cats, and a rabbit too? I love it!
...Oh, so that's why you wanted to go. All right, let's go together.
Meow... I did warn you. Don't get lost.
Don't worry too much, Binah. It'll be fine.
strings.후후, 비나. %s 님이 괜찮다면 괜찮은 거예여. 게다가 마을 안에 있잖: Hehe, Binah. If %s says it'll be fine, it'll be fine. And we're still inside the village.
strings.그렇게 말씀하신다면야…. 그러면 오실 때 이것 좀 찾아주실래요?: If you say so... Then could you find something for me on your way back?
strings.플라워 스톤이라는 꽃 모양 보석이에요. 예전에 엄마가 창고에다가 넣고 어: It's a flower-shaped gem called a Flower Stone. Mom put it in the warehouse long ago and forgot where, so we haven't been able to find it.
If I find it, I'll bring it.
strings.감샤합니다. 냥. 들어갔는데, 이게 아닌 것 같은 느낌이 들면 바로 나오: Thank mew. Meow. If you go in and feel something's wrong, come straight back out. Understood?
strings.후후, 바로 나올게여. 우후후, 대왕 토끼다. 왕 토끼도 아니고 대왕 토: Hehe, we'll come right out. Ohoho, a giant rabbit! Not just a big rabbit, a giant one!
strings.(창고가 저 티팟 모양 건물이었지. 밖에서 보면 작아 보이네. 일단 가서: (The warehouse is that teapot-shaped building. It looks small from outside. Let's go and see.)
strings.(레티시아가 주위를 두리번거리며 감탄을 멈추지 않는다. 그 정도로 먼치킨: (Leticia keeps looking around in amazement. The Munchkin Warehouse is enormous, with every corner packed with all manner of objects.)
I can't believe this is a warehouse...
strings.비나가 들어가지 말라고 했던 이유를 알겠어여. 넓기도 넓은데, 무슨 물건: Now I know why Binah told us not to enter. It's huge, and how can there be so much stuff? Wow...
Why are the display cases and cabinets taller than a castle...?
strings.높기도 높지만 끝이 보이지 않아여. 그래도 가는 길은 잘 보이네여. 모험: They're tall, and I can't even see where they end. But I can see the path clearly. Adventurer, let's go that way.
strings.고양이 발바닥 그림이 그려진 길, 너무 귀엽지 않아여? 저기 있는 기둥은: Isn't the path painted with cat paw prints adorable? And that pillar is a scratching post for cats...
Silvia should see cute things like this too...
strings.(일행이 앞으로 가려는 순간, 어디선가 누군가가 의외의 인물을 언급하는: (As the group moves forward, a voice from somewhere mentions an unexpected person.)
strings.…어디서 들려오는 거지? %s 님, 판도라라는 사람 아세여?: ...Where did that come from? %s, do you know someone called Pandora?
strings.「언젠가 널 만났던 것 같은 기분이 드는데…. 이름이 %s? %s…. 그: 「I feel as though I've met you before... Your name is %s? %s... Yes, that name...」
strings.「판도라의 냄새가 난다 했더니 그 인간이었군. 감히 나를, 감히 나를!!: 「I thought I smelled Pandora. So it's that human. How dare you... How dare you!!」
strings.(의문의 목소리가 화를 내자 창고 안이 흔들린다. 그러자 잔뜩 쌓여있던: (As the mysterious voice grows angry, the warehouse shakes. Objects piled high begin falling to the floor one by one.)
Look, I don't know who you are, but I'd appreciate it if you left the warehouse alone.
strings.「나를 엉망으로 만든 주제에 기억을 못 해? 기고만장한 인간. 그러면 여: 「You made a wreck of me, and you don't remember? Arrogant human. Then I'll make you cause trouble here. Choose: die by my hand, or by Glinda's.」
「First, you'll have to come meet me. I'll make sure the journey isn't boring. Enjoy a little entertainment!!」
strings.(그 말과 함께 흔들렸던 창고의 움직임이 멈춘다. 하지만, 다른 움직임이: (The shaking stops at those words. But something else approaches rapidly, as though to pin %s's group in place.)
strings.냥! 친구들아. 우리 합주를 방해하러 온 침입자다!: Meow! Friends, intruders have come to interrupt our ensemble!
Meow! We cannot forgive anyone who ruins the performance of the century.
strings.냥! 관중을 위해 연주 중인데, 불청객이 오다니!!: Meow! We're playing for an audience, and these uninvited guests turn up!!
strings.%s 님, 먼치킨 일족 상태가 많이 이상해여. 며칠 동안 인사하고 같이: %s, the Munchkins are acting really strange. We've greeted each other and eaten together for days. I even laughed at their weird dad jokes!!
strings.으, 저, 저기. 요리 정령 요리조리가 칼 들고 우리한테 뛰어와여!!: Uh, l-look! The Elusive Boss, the cooking spirit, is running at us with a knife!!
strings.맨 정신으로 이야기할 수 없을 것 같은 상황이예여!!: I don't think they're in any state to talk sensibly!!
strings.아까 들려온 목소리가 모두를 조종하는 것 같은데…. 후아, 어쩔 수 없나: That voice seems to be controlling everyone... Phew. I suppose we have no choice but to meet its owner.
Phewww. I don't think they're chasing us anymore.
strings.(레티시아가 이마에 흐르는 땀을 닦고 모험가를 바라본다.): (Leticia wipes sweat from her forehead and looks at the adventurer.)
No matter how far we go, it never ends.
strings.(모험가가 주위를 둘러보는 순간, 두 사람의 머리 위에 커다란 그림자가: (As the adventurer looks around, a huge shadow falls over both of you.)
strings.(모험가가 레티시아를 밀쳐내고 앞으로 떨어지는 존재의 공격을 막아낸다.): (The adventurer shoves Leticia aside and blocks the attack of something falling from above.)
strings.(위력이 엄청나…. 자꾸 뒤로 밀리네.): (Such incredible force... It keeps pushing me back.)
strings.(레티시아가 적으로 보이는 대상에게 킥 공격을 하려고 하는 순간, 커다란: (Just as Leticia moves to kick the apparent enemy, the huge figure retreats with heavy thuds.)
So you made it this far... This time, I'll kill you properly.
strings.(적의 등장과 함께 자욱했던 창고의 먼지가 조금씩 사라진다. 그리고 그: (As the enemy appears, the thick warehouse dust gradually clears, slowly revealing its enormous form.)
strings.(거대한 흰토끼 인형이 충혈된 것 같은 빨간 눈으로 두 사람을 바라보고: (A gigantic white rabbit doll stares at you both with red, bloodshot-looking eyes.)
strings.(검은색 흰색 조합의 예쁜 고딕 드레스와 검은색 장미 안대, 하얀색의 미: (It wears a lovely black-and-white Gothic dress, a black rose eyepatch, and a small white hat, creating a peculiar air.)
A rampaging rabbit monster? No, it's a doll I've seen somewhere... It looks familiar...
strings.크아악, 누구 보고 솜뭉치래? 누가 날뛰는 토끼 괴물이야? 토끼가 뭐 어: Graaagh! Who are you calling a bundle of fluff? Who's a rampaging rabbit monster? What's wrong with rabbits?!
If you've got eyes, look for yourself. Bunny-bunny.
strings.(레티시아가 창고 안에 걸려 있는 거울을 가리킨다.): (Leticia points to a mirror hanging in the warehouse.)
strings.나를, 나를 이런 식으로 넣어놓고는 사라져?!: She put me... Put me in something like this and disappeared?!
strings.나하고 판도라 님을 어떻게 알고 있는 거지? 대체 누구야?: How do you know me and Pandora? Who are you?
strings.루세리아? 루세리아…. 흠…. 아, 아…? 별자리 절벽에 있던 그 루세리: Luceria? Luceria... Hmm... Oh? The Luceria from Constellation Cliff! But why are you here?
strings.그러면 버니버니 루세리아! 인형님 정체가 뭐예여?: Then you're Bunny Bunny Luceria! What's your true identity, Ms. Doll?
Graaagh!! How dare you call me Bunny Bunny...
You're a rabbit doll that squeaks every time you move.
Letty, step back. This is dangerous. A doll containing the soul of a dangerous witch...
strings.인형, 인형이라고 하지마!! 난 살아있다고!: Stop calling me a doll! I'm alive!
strings.(거대한 토끼 인형 - 버니버니 루세리아가 화를 내며 몸부림치자, 먼치: (As the enormous rabbit doll, Bunny Bunny Luceria, thrashes in anger, the magic filling the Munchkin Warehouse gathers in one place.)
Ugh, all that powerful magic is flowing into Bunny Bunny...
strings.버니버니 아니라고 했지!! 나는 루세리아라고!!: I told you I'm not Bunny Bunny!! I'm Luceria!!
strings.(분노 가득안 외침과 함께 마력이 버니버니 루세리아에게로 향하면서 창고: (With that furious shout, magic flows toward Bunny Bunny Luceria, and the warehouse continues shaking.)
strings.버니버니 인형님, 알았어여. 그만 해여!!: All right, Ms. Bunny Bunny Doll. Stop it!!
strings.멈춰! 이대로 가다간 창고가 무너진다고!: Stop! At this rate, the warehouse will collapse!
Still calling me a doll and Bunny Bunny to the very end...
strings.현혹의 루세리아를 무시한 대가를 톡톡히 치르게 해 주지. 죽어라!!: You'll pay dearly for insulting Luceria of Allure. Die!!
strings.(그 말과 함께 엄청난 마력을 실은 토끼 인형의 공격이 다시 %s 일행을: (With those words, the rabbit doll unleashes another attack filled with immense magic at %s's group.)
strings.(%s의 공격을 받은 버니버니 루세리아가 뒤로 밀려난다.): (Struck by %s's attack, Bunny Bunny Luceria is driven backward.)
strings.(커다란 인형 손으로 다시 마력을 모아 공격하려고 하지만, 그대로 푹 주: (She tries to gather magic in her huge doll hands and attack again, but sinks to the floor.)
strings.(잠깐 이 소리는…. 왜 여기까지 들려오는 거야?): (Wait, that sound... Why can I hear it all the way here?)
strings.(버니버니 루세리아가 다시 솜뭉치 검을 들어 휘두르려고 하지만, 그대로: (Bunny Bunny Luceria tries to raise and swing her stuffed sword again, but falls flat on her face.)
strings.아직 난 할 수 있어. 할 수 있다고! 현혹의 루세리아가 여기서 무너질: I can still do this. I can! Luceria of Allure cannot fall here!
strings.(레티시아가 다가가 쓰러진 버니버니 루세리아를 일으켜 벽에 기대게 해준다: (Leticia approaches, lifts the fallen Bunny Bunny Luceria, and props her against the wall.)
strings.흐엉. 흐어어엉. 창고의 마력을 모두 다 끌어 썼는데 이 모양이라니. 이: Boohoo. Waaaah. I used every bit of magic in the warehouse, and this is the result? It's strange. Why is this happening?
strings.(버니버니 루세리아가 억울하고 분했는지 축 늘어진 채로 우는 소리를 낸다: (Bunny Bunny Luceria slumps and sobs, sounding frustrated and wronged.)
strings.흐어엉. 흐엉. 너 같으면 진정하겠냐. 백 년 넘게 인형 속에서 이러고: Waaaah. Would you calm down? I've been trapped in a doll for over a hundred years.
strings.아녀! 진정 못 하져. 얼마나 억울하겠어여!: Nope! I couldn't calm down either. That would feel so unfair!
I'd have been better off dying from the beginning like the other witches. At least I'd be at peace. But this...
strings.그런 말이 어디 있어여. 그래서 님 다른 마녀 죽인 거예여?: How can you say that? So did you kill other witches?
I ended up like this while trying to kill Pandora, so no.
strings.그런데 왜 여기 있는 거야? 판도라 님과 함께 있던 게 아니었어?: But why are you here? Weren't you with Pandora?
strings.(판도라의 이름이 나오자 버니버니 루세리아가 빤히 %s의 얼굴을 바라본다: (At Pandora's name, Bunny Bunny Luceria stares intently at %s's face.)
strings.%s 님, 이야기 나누세여. 저는 저쪽에서 먼치킨 일족 뭐하나 보고 있을: %s, you two talk. I'll go see what the Munchkins are doing over there.
Sigh. Then ask what you want to know.
strings.하아…. 지금은 지엔디아 대륙의 유일한 마녀가 판도라겠지? 예전엔 지엔디: Sigh... Pandora must be the only witch left on the continent of Jiendia now. There used to be many witches there...
strings.어느 순간 마녀로 각성한 무리가 밤을 쫓으면서 그림자에 숨어있던 판도라를: At some point, a group who had awakened as witches chased the night and found Pandora hiding in the shadows.
strings.인간을 초월한 능력을 지닌 아가슈라이자 마녀. 마녀로 각성한 존재들에게: An Agasura and a witch, with abilities beyond human limits. To newly awakened witches, Pandora was an irresistible target.
If they killed Pandora, they could become Jiendia's strongest witch.
strings.판도라는 마녀의 유희에 관심이 없었고, 그냥 그들과 상대하기 싫어서 적당: Pandora had no interest in the witches' games. She didn't want to deal with them, so she set a few traps and drove them away.
strings.직접적으로 판도라가 죽인 마녀의 수는 얼마 없어. 몇은 함정에 빠져 죽거: Pandora directly killed only a few witches. Some died in traps, and others were murdered by other people.
Before long, only Pandora and I remained in Jiendia.
Back then, I didn't merely dislike Pandora. I despised her.
My father taught her forbidden arts he wouldn't even teach me.
strings.그것만 있으면 난 정말 최고의 마녀가 되는 거였어. 내가 아닌 다른 사람: With that knowledge, I could have become the greatest witch. I hated that Father had taught it to someone other than me.
strings.그래서 판도라를 죽이고 내가 최고가 되려고 했던 거야. 지금은 이런 모습: So I tried to kill Pandora and become the greatest myself. I may look like this now, but I was quite something back then.
strings.그런데 판도라는 패배한 날 죽이지 않았어. 오히려 내 육체가 잘못된 방법: But after defeating me, Pandora didn't kill me. When she saw my body collapsing in an unnatural way, she caught my soul.
strings.그게 아빠가 알고 있던 금단의 비법이었어. 영혼을 다른 곳에 옮길 수 있: That was the forbidden technique Father knew. The ability to transfer a soul elsewhere...
He was just a mad mage.
strings.그런데 영혼이 실험용으로 마수 수백 마리를 봉인한 인형 안에 들어간 거지: But my soul went into a doll containing hundreds of demonic beasts sealed for experiments. Pandora said there was nowhere else suitable for it...
That technique works only once, so I can't be moved elsewhere. Sigh...
strings.아, 인형 속 마수들 있다고 했었지? 쓰러뜨려서 영혼까지 완벽하게 소멸시: Oh, I mentioned the beasts inside the doll, right? I defeated them and completely destroyed their souls. Then one day, when I came to, I remembered things.
Including fighting some drifter who seemed to have only just begun adventuring...
You mean me. I think a human-shaped soul came out of the doll...
strings.옛 모습이 이젠 기억도 나질 않네. 아, 몰라. 판도라가 왜 날 여기 뒀: I can't even remember my old appearance now. Oh, I don't know. I don't know why Pandora left me here. On a warehouse shelf, of all places, when there are so many others...
She used me when it suited her, then put me in storage because I was useless...
One day, she came and said she'd look for a way to restore my original form.
strings.더는 싸우지 않아야 해준대. 안 그러면 마을 주인인 마녀 글린다한테 혼날: But only if I stopped fighting. Otherwise, the village's owner, the witch Glinda, might punish me.
So I agreed to stay quiet. Then she brought Glinda.
strings.그때 인형이 너무 낡아서 좀 더 큰 몸이면 좋겠다고 하지 말 걸 그랬나: I shouldn't have said the doll was so worn out that I wanted a bigger body.
strings.글린다가 큰 토끼 인형을 만들어서 내 앞에 두더라. …아니, 사람같은 인: Glinda made a huge rabbit doll and put it before me. Couldn't she have made one shaped like a person?
strings.판도라가 보더니 너무 예쁜 인형이라면서 잠자코 들어가라는 거야. 자기 몸: Pandora said it was a beautiful doll and told me to get inside without complaining. Easy for her; it wasn't her body.
strings.하아. 어쩌겠어. 원래 모습까진 아니더라도 인간처럼 살게 해준다는데 기다: Sigh. What can I do? She says she'll let me live like a human, even if I can't regain my original form. I have to wait.
So that's why I'm guarding the warehouse.
strings.%s 너, 내게 물어볼 게 인형 말곤 없는 거야?: %s, don't you have anything to ask besides questions about dolls?
For now, no. I met Pandora after she left here...
strings.뭐야? 어디서 만난 거야? 방법을 찾았대?: What? Where did you meet her? Did she find a way?
strings.(축 처져 있던 버니버니 루세리아가 판도라의 이름을 듣자마자 벌떡 일어난: (The slumped Bunny Bunny Luceria springs up at Pandora's name, but quickly loses strength and falls over again.)
strings.흐어엉…. 몸도 못 가누다니…. 그래서 판도라는 지금 어디 있어?: Waaaah... I can't even hold myself up... So where is Pandora now?
strings.(버니버니 루세리아에게 아틀라스 정원에서 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (You tell Bunny Bunny Luceria what happened in Atlas Garden.)
strings.신의 진리가 있던 장소를 찾아냈는데, 정작 진리 같은 건 없었고…. 다프: So she found the place where divine truth had been, but no truth remained... She tried to use Daphne, only to be deceived herself and bound by a contract.
Knowing Pandora, I thought she'd seek a way without killing witches.
Sigh... How long must I stay in this doll...?
strings.제가 최대한 찾아볼게. ……어?: I'll do everything I can to find a way... Huh?
strings.(그런 그때, 멈췄던 쓸쓸한 현악기 연주 소리가 정신 차린 먼치킨 음악대: (Just then, the lonely string music that had stopped returns, mingling with the wind instruments of the recovered Munchkin band.)
strings.먼치킨 녀석들이 정신 차리자마자, 또 연주 하네. 으…, 시끄러워. 엥?: The Munchkins are playing again the moment they come to their senses. Ugh, noisy. Hm?
strings.……여기에 첼로 같은 걸 연주하던 먼치킨이 있었던가?: ...Was there a Munchkin here who played something like a cello?
strings.갑자기 졸리네……. 왜 이러지. 인형 되고 잠이 든 적이 한 번도 없는데: I'm suddenly sleepy... Why? I've never fallen asleep once since becoming a doll...
strings.(말을 이어가던 버니버니 루세리아의 움직임이 멈춘다. 그러더니 그대로 %: (Bunny Bunny Luceria stops moving mid-sentence, then collapses in front of %s.)
strings.(버니버니 루세리아가 깊은 잠에 빠진 것처럼 코고는 소리를 낸다.): (Bunny Bunny Luceria snores as though deeply asleep.)
strings.잠깐 일어나 봐. 루세리아, 루세리아!: Wake up for a moment. Luceria! Luceria!
strings.(아무리 흔들어보지만 루세리아는 미동도 전혀 하지 않는다.): (No matter how much you shake her, Luceria does not stir.)
What should I do? It seems to be because of that music...
Huh, why is Ms. Bunny Bunny Witch sleeping?
strings.(레티시아가 어디선가 이불 같은 걸 찾아 누워있는 버니버니 루세리아를 덮: (Leticia finds something like a blanket and covers the sleeping Bunny Bunny Luceria.)
strings.무슨 일인지는 잘 모르겠지만, 일단은 끝난 거 맞져? 비나가 이야기했던: I don't really know, but we're finished for now, right? I found the thing Binah mentioned too.
Oh, that's it. Thank you, Letty.
strings.뭘여. 그런데 이 마을에 글린다 님 같은 마녀도 살고 있으니까 버니버니: It's nothing. Since a witch like Glinda lives in this village, Ms. Bunny Bunny Witch isn't a secret, right?
For now, no. And Bunny Bunny... Oh... She's already covering her ears in her sleep...
strings.(분명 루세리아도 나처럼 그 음악 소리를 들었어…. 그 음악을 듣고 잠이: (Luceria definitely heard the same music I did... If it put her to sleep, it should have affected me too. Why...?)
strings.%s 님. 일단 밖에서 식사하면서 생각해 봐여. 요리조리 사장님이 늦게: %s, let's think about it over a meal outside. The Elusive Boss said if we're late, there won't even be soup left.
Graaagh, Pandora. I'll k-kill you. Snore...
She seems fine. Let's go, Letty.
Graaagh! I hate carrots. Don't put one in my hand. Snore...
strings.냐아아앙?! 날뛰는 거대한 토끼 인형에 마녀의 영혼이 있다구요?: Mee-owww?! There's a witch's soul inside a giant rampaging rabbit doll?
strings.(비나가 플라워 스톤을 받아 들고는 믿을 수 없다는 표정을 짓는다.): (Binah accepts the Flower Stone with a look of disbelief.)
The witch was violent, but the doll was cute.
Meow... It sounds adorable. I want to see it...
strings.그냥 나중에 봐야겠어요. 창고 중간쯤 들어갔다 나오는데도 구조 요청을 해: I'll have to wait. I need rescuing just to get back from halfway through the warehouse, and she's in the deepest part...
Well, the giant rabbit witch doll can come outside when she wants.
She's asleep now, so tell Glinda later and go see her together.
strings.냥. 그럴게요. 하여튼 괴담도 파헤쳐 주시고, 말씀드린 물건도 찾아주시고: Meow. I will. Anyway, thank you for solving the ghost story and finding what I asked for.
strings.창고에 가실 동안 요리조리 사장님하고 셰프님하고 선생님이 만든 음식 챙겨: While you were in the warehouse, I saved food made by the Elusive Boss, the chef, and the teacher. Come inside and eat with us.
Chocolate cream parfait, vongole pasta, and what else...? Anyway, there's plenty.
strings.(어, 그런데 비나 고양이 수인인데, 초콜릿 먹어도 되나….): (Wait, Binah is a cat beastfolk. Can she eat chocolate...?)
strings.%s 님 표정 뭔지 알아요! 저 괜찮아요. 어릴 때 잔뜩 먹었지만, 안: I know that look, %s! I'm fine. I ate lots when I was little, and I didn't die! I still eat it now. Hehe, come inside. Meow.
strings.(비나와 레티시아에 이어 집 안으로 들어가려는 모험가의 시야에 마을을 지: (As the adventurer follows Binah and Leticia toward the house, a stranger passing through the village catches your eye.)
What a miserable village. Hardly worth coming to inspect.
strings.(저 사람, 누구지…? 마을 사람은 아닌 것 같은데…. 잠깐, 뿔? 날개: (Who is that...? He doesn't look like a villager... Wait, horns? Wings? And a tail...)
strings.(모험가를 지나치던 남자가 발걸음을 멈추고 뒤돌아본다.): (The man passing the adventurer stops and turns.)
Ha, interesting. You not only sense my presence, but can see me clearly... Impressive for a human.
strings.글쎄, 내가 누굴까?: Who do you think I am?
strings.(남자가 조소를 보이며 머리를 쓸어넘긴다. 그러자 그의 머리에 달려있던: (With a sneer, the man sweeps back his hair, making the horns on his head stand out more clearly.)
You're going to die anyway. It wouldn't hurt to tell you my name.
Lord Tip, descendant of the great black dragon.
strings.(그 말과 함께 팁의 허리에 있던 날개가 활짝 펼쳐진다.): (With those words, the wings at Tip's waist spread wide.)
strings.(…몸의 비늘, 날개, 꼬리까지 전부 드래곤과 비슷하긴 한데….): (...The scales, wings, and tail all resemble a dragon's...)
It might be fun to cut you down with this.
strings.(모험가가 팁을 경계하던 중, 갑자기 팁이 머리에 두 손가락을 올리고 눈: (As the adventurer watches Tip warily, he suddenly presses two fingers to his head and closes his eyes.)
strings.「티페타, 알았다. 뭐, 잠깐 기다리지.」: 「Tipeta, understood. Fine. I'll wait a little.」
strings.(팁이 검을 거두고는 모험가를 향해 가볍게 웃는다.): (Tip puts away his sword and gives the adventurer a slight smile.)
A shame, but it seems this isn't the time. Sigh.
strings.(팁이 한숨을 내쉬며 제자리에서 뛰어오른다. 그리곤 아래에 있는 모험가를: (Sighing, Tip leaps into the air and looks down at the adventurer.)
You'll find out soon enough, adventurer %s.
strings.(할 말을 마친 팁이 힘차게 날갯짓하며 하늘로 솟아올라 모습을 감춘다.): (Having said his piece, Tip beats his wings, soars into the sky, and disappears.)
strings.말하는 걸로 봐선 분명 무슨 짓을 꾸미는 것 같은데. 어, 글린다 님?: From the way he talked, he's definitely plotting something. Huh, Glinda?
strings.(그렇게 하늘을 바라보고 있던 %s의 앞으로 글린다가 뛰어온다.): (As %s watches the sky, Glinda comes running over.)
strings.(글린다가 %s의 상태를 확인하고는 꺼내려고 했던 검을 그대로 검집에 밀: (After checking %s's condition, Glinda pushes the sword she was about to draw back into its sheath and turns away as though nothing happened.)
strings.(글린다가 다가온 모험가의 얼굴을 보기 싫은 듯 부채를 들어 얼굴을 가린: (As the adventurer approaches, Glinda raises her fan to hide her face, as though unwilling to look at you.)
strings.글린다 님, 왜 아무 말씀도 안 하시는 거죠?: Glinda, why aren't you saying anything?
You saw that man. That's why you came over to me...
It's nothing. It doesn't concern you. Cough, cough.
strings.도로시 마을은 글린다 님의 허락이 있어야만 들어올 수 있다고 했는데, 그: You said people need your permission to enter Dorothy Village. Did that man also...?
strings.아무 일도 없었잖아. 그러면 된 거야. 쿨럭, 쿨럭. 내가 알아서 할 테: Nothing happened, did it? Then that's enough. Cough, cough. I'll handle it. Don't concern yourself.
All right. But you don't seem well...
It's only a cold. I've taken medicine, so I'll recover.
strings.쿨럭, 쿨럭. 그러면 알아들은 걸로 받아들일게. 그대는 돌아가서 비나와: Cough, cough. Then I'll take it that you understand. Go back and keep Binah company. Go on...
strings.(당장 어떤 대답도 못 들을 것 같네…. 나중에 이야기해 보자. 가능할진: (It doesn't seem I'll get any answers right now... I'll try talking later. If I can...)
strings.(글린다가 대화를 포기하고 돌아가는 모험가를 말없이 바라본다.): (Glinda silently watches the adventurer give up the conversation and leave.)
strings.그때 사악한 용인(龍人)들도 함께 봉인했다고 생각했는데, 이렇게 나타날: I thought the wicked dragonfolk were sealed away together back then. To think they would appear like this...
For now, I'll investigate a little more...
